# T57.ai

> T57 is an AI-native digital trade platform for food. It connects verified farmers, processors, traders, buyers, financiers, service providers and regulators on one trade record, from quote to payment. T57 does not lend or hold funds; finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

T57 works with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), an OIC institution, under a 10-year memorandum of understanding, and has signed more than 150 memoranda and letters of intent across 67 countries. Founding markets: Saudi Arabia, UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.

## Who we serve

- [Who We Serve](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve): T57 exists to connect everyone who grows, makes, buys, finances and regulates food on one trusted record.
- [Governments and Regulators](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Live trade data, food-security alerts and transparent tenders, in one view for ministries and agencies.
- [Financiers and Investors](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Every deal comes with verified parties, documents and shipment data, from deal to settlement.
- [Sellers and Exporters](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Find buyers, agree terms and get paid, with finance and logistics on one platform.
- [Traders and Aggregators](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Match supply and demand faster, with verified partners, live prices and finance for each deal.
- [Buyers and Importers](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Compare verified suppliers, track every shipment and pay only when terms are met.
- [Manufacturers and Enterprises](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Source from verified producers, see price moves early and run every contract in one place.
- [Food Processors](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Steady raw materials from verified farms, with quality checks and finance built in.
- [Cooperatives and FPOs](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Pool produce, reach bigger buyers and pay members faster, with every trade on record.
- [Partners and Collaborators](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): Development partners, associations and institutions reach the whole food chain through one platform.
- [Service Providers](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Inspection, logistics, legal and advisory firms are matched to live trades that need them.
- [Farmers and Producers](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Reach verified buyers directly, see market prices and get paid faster.

## Common questions

- [What is T57?](https://t57.ai/): T57 is AI-native digital trade infrastructure for the food industry. It brings verification, quotes, contracts, finance access, insurance, inspection and logistics onto one trade record for verified members.
- [Who can join T57?](https://t57.ai/): Any business in the food chain can apply, including farmers, fishers, processors, manufacturers, brands, traders, importers, wholesalers, supermarkets and HoReCa buyers. Every member is verified before trading.
- [Who can join T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve): Any business or institution in the food chain can apply, from farmers and fishers to processors, brands, traders, importers, supermarkets, HoReCa buyers, lenders, insurers, service providers and government bodies.
- [Why does T57 verify every member?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve): Verification lets every member trade with confidence. It also gives lenders and insurers the trusted information they need to support a trade.
- [How does T57 support national and regional food-security strategies in practice?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Many countries are now expanding strategic reserves and silo capacity to hold months’ worth of essential commodities. T57 complements such physical infrastructure by tracking self-sufficiency, stock levels, and import exposure in real time. This combination of physical reserves and digital intelligence helps governments move from reactive to anticipatory food-security management.
- [Why is it important to channel private and impact capital into agriculture and food systems, beyond public budgets?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Despite agriculture’s historical role in employment and food security, global investors are only now seeking credible, measurable pathways to support food systems as part of their climate and SDG commitments. T57 helps governments present investable, data-backed opportunities, from model support centers to special agri zones and CSR programs, with transparent performance and impact tracking that meets both regulatory and investor expectations.
- [How does T57 handle disputes and reduce risks for financiers and investors?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): T57 reduces risk through its curated club membership model, which ensures vetted, credible counterparties in a high-trust environment. Its virtual trade desk supports execution, manages disputes, oversees documentation, and ensures consistent transaction follow-through for greater investor confidence.
- [Why is food and agri finance an important opportunity for investors now?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Global food import demand remains enormous: FAO puts the global food import bill at $2.22 trillion in 2025, which underlines the scale and persistence of trade-linked financing needs in food markets.
- [How does T57's virtual trade desk help in disputes and risk management?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): The virtual trade desk acts as a risk manager. In the event of disputes, the desk steps in to mediate, enforce agreed-upon terms and protect the seller's interests. If a buyer becomes insolvent or defaults, T57 shifts to a commission-based recovery and resale approach, helping redirect goods or recover value.
- [How does a platform help with the financing gap?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Dedicated trade platforms that provide rich transaction and compliance data can lower perceived risk for financiers, improving access to credit and reducing the cost of capital. T57 is designed to expose this data in an auditable way so that funders can underwrite your deals with greater confidence.
- [Can intermediaries join T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Yes. Traders and intermediaries are welcome. They are labelled by role so every counterparty knows how the trade is structured.
- [Does T57 lend to traders?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): No. T57 does not lend. It sends your deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.
- [How does T57 verify suppliers?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): T57 runs business and identity checks, compliance screening and, where needed, a physical check of the supplier's premises. Each verified supplier receives a T57 Passport and a role label.
- [Can I buy only from producers?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Yes. Role labels show whether a supplier is an owner-producer, processor, trader or intermediary, so you can filter for producers.
- [Why do manufacturers and enterprises need a digital trade workflow now?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Digital trade workflow is important for countering high losses, volatility, and operational friction in the industry. FAO reports 13.3% food loss before retail, while the World Bank points to ongoing food inflation and uneven commodity movement across markets.
- [How does T57 help reduce procurement risk?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): T57 helps structure RFQs, centralize bid visibility, and support trade in a more verified counterparty environment. In volatile markets, faster sourcing decisions and improved documentation can help protect supply continuity and margins.
- [Why is digitizing trade especially important for food processors?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Processors depend on timely and predictable raw material supplies and operate on tight margins. Supply assurance and trade execution platforms make inputs more predictable, optimize capacity utilization, and protect margins in volatile markets.
- [Does T57 help with working capital and financing challenges?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Partner banks, escrow structures, faster eLC workflows, and tokenized-trade capabilities are designed to shorten settlement cycles and connect real trade to innovative finance solutions. For processors, that can mean less cash stuck in transit and more capacity to invest in inventory, maintenance, or growth.
- [Why do cooperatives & FPOs need digital platforms like T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Scale alone is not enough. Cooperatives and FPOs need systems that professionalize operations, improve market access, and strengthen bargaining power. When properly supported and organized by platforms like T57, agricultural cooperatives play a critical role in sustainable agrifood systems and food security.
- [How do members gain when their cooperative or FPO wins government tenders or a contract farming agreement?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Government tenders and contract farming agreements lock in demand and timelines, so members know what to produce, when it will be picked up, and at what terms, which leads to more consistent prices and lower post-harvest losses. T57 helps members plan volumes and crop mix, match supply to tender requirements, coordinate logistics and documentation, and track fulfillment and payments in one place, turning tender wins and contracts into a distributed benefit for individual farmers.
- [How do T57 partners help me reach better markets?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): T57's vetted partners help you meet standards, reliably move produce, and access premium capabilities to help you grow, without having to build these relationships yourself.
- [What kind of partners can I access on T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): You can connect with a diverse range of partners who help you meet complex compliance requirements, reduce logistics losses, unlock financing and insurance, accelerate innovation, and turn more of your effort into predictable, higher-value trade outcomes.
- [How is T57 different from a simple marketplace?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): T57 is built on verified participants, trade-linked workflows, and governed execution, not just listings and introductions.
- [Can I offer services across borders without a local office?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Yes. T57 is designed to help providers engage digitally across regions while reducing friction in discovery, contracting, and payment processes.
- [Why should a farmer or producer use a digital trade platform like T57?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): T57 provides access to verified buyers and transparent payment processes. This reduces uncertainty and improves income realization.
- [What should farmers watch out for in contract farming?](https://t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Contract farming deals are often between stronger buyers and weaker farmers. This could result in unfair terms, over-dependence on a single buyer, or disputes over quality and deductions. Farmers can access T57's expertise to negotiate the best terms.
